Hi Ben,

Thanks for the quick response on the RFP. Attached is a short questionnaire and the high-level sizing requirements from our infra and ML teams (attached: Orion_RFP_Capacity_Reqs.pdf). High-level summary:

- Workload: hybrid real-time chat + asynchronous batch scoring (embeddings + reranking)
- Expected sustained load: ~250k generated tokens/day across workloads (average)
- Peak concurrency: ~15 real-time sessions at 512-token prompt + generation (p50 ~100 tokens generated per session); burst tolerance up to 60 concurrent for 10-minute windows
- Latency SLO: p95 <120ms for 128-token generations, p99 <150ms for 512-token runs (US regions)
- Primary models: Llama2-70B (production quality), Redwood-v1-13B for lower-cost routing; some distill/quantized variants acceptable
- Preferred GPUs: H100-80GB for the 70B model footprint; L4 or similar for smaller variants and embeddings
- Regions: us-west primary, eu-west secondary; data residency and SOC2 expected
- Contract horizon: 12 months reserved + burst pool; looking for pricing for 1yr commitment and on/off ramp for 3mo trial credits

Can you complete the attached questionnaire with recommended GPU counts, expected throughput, and a proposed reservation plan (base reserved pool + burst)? Also include any assumptions for batching, KV cache sizing, and expected token/sec per GPU for the models above.

Please loop in your solutions/engineering lead so we can get a completed worksheet by next week. We are running procurement timelines for a November kickoff.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Head of Procurement 
Orion Analytics

Ben / Lauren — I populated the sizing workbook and sketched two concrete reservation options. Uploaded workbook to the shared Drive (link in final email). Key assumptions (please verify with Orion):

- Model mix (steady): 60% Llama2-70B gen traffic, 30% Redwood-v1-13B, 10% embeddings/reranks (batch)
- Average tokens per real-time session: 100 generated tokens (512 token context for safety)
- Workday peak distribution: 60% of peak during 0800-1800 local; 20% overnight; bursts randomly distributed
- KV cache hit: assume 35% prefix reuse for customer sessions (reduces repeat perf cost)

Sizing summary (estimates):
- Option A — H100-focused reserved baseline
  - Target throughput: sustain 12 concurrent 512-token gen sessions at p95 latency targets
  - Estimated GPUs: H100-80GB x 6 dedicated (reserve) => ~1.2M tokens/hour sustained for Llama2-70B workload with batching & KV caching (assumes avg batch 4)
  - Burst: allow additional 6 ephemeral H100 capacity via burst/priority pool (adds headroom for 60 concurrent minutes)
  - Estimated monthly reserved cost (list estimate): $198k/mo (12-mo commit), burst at usage-based rates

- Option B — Hybrid (cost-optimized)
  - Reserved: H100-80GB x 3 + L4 x 10 (L4 for 13B and embeddings)
  - Routing: Redwood router sends 70% of lower-complexity 70B requests to quantized 13B when quality tolerates it (saves ~40% GPU cost)
  - Estimated monthly reserved cost: $122k/mo (12-mo commit) + slightly higher p99 latency during peak if autoscale lag occurs

Operational notes / risks:
- Canaries: recommend a canary pool (1-2 GPUs per region) for model rollouts.
- Autoscale warmup: cold-start of additional H100 nodes ~45–90s to reach full throughput — suggest burst pool for short spikes.
- Data residency & logging: we can ensure audit logs and KMS integration; SOC2 evidence ready for review.

Questions for Orion (please confirm so we can finalize workbook):
1) Confirm the intended model mix during peak vs baseline (is 60/30/10 fixed?)
2) Are you willing to accept occasional p99 latency degradations in exchange for cost savings via hybrid routing?
3) Bandwidth for cross-region replication (we assumed 10 Gbps peering for KV sync)

Attachments included: sizing_workbook_populated.xlsx (Excel), api_latency_profile.csv (CSV).

I added per-GPU token/sec assumptions per model in the workbook. If Orion confirms the model mix and region split, I will finalize the reserved numbers and provide a one-page procurement summary with commit-level pricing.

-Rishi
